top_signals.title: CMT Launches Engine Pressure Drop Tester for Ship Operators
top_signals.summary: Germany's CM Technologies (CMT) has launched a compact pressure drop testing instrument designed to help ship operators detect cylinder pressure leaks early, enabling them to address engine wear before it leads to higher fuel consumption, costly…
